{{Quote|Ah, the scene of some of my most poignant triumphs&hellip;so reassuring to know I can always impress the females with a high-class restaurant. At least it's the closest you can come to one in Mos Eisley. Blistine water fountains, and nuragem tiles&hellip;oh yes, so tasteful.|[[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]] describes the Court of the Fountain|audio=CourtOfTheFountain.flac|<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
'''Court of the Fountain''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-owned exotic restaurant in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. It was situated near [[Outer Curved Street/Legends|Outer Curved Street]].

The restaurant was in a stone and stucco palace and featured fountains and exotic plants. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] personal chef, [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], worked as head chef there on the rare occasions that Jabba didn't need him.
